class.name: PCKPackage
class.brief_description: A [code].pck[/code] file as a resource: an opened pack, or a pack description that can be built.

method.name: add_file
method.description: Adds the file [param source_path] to the package as [param target_path], or replaces the entry with that path. Only the source path is recorded: the file does not need to exist yet, and its data is read when the pack is built. [method PCKPackageServer.build] fails with [constant ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND] and lists all sources that are missing then. The size and MD5 sum of the entry stay [code]0[/code] until the pack is built. If [param encrypt] is [code]true[/code], the file is encrypted with the key used by [method PCKPackageServer.build]. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param target_path] is empty or a folder, or if [param source_path] is empty.

method.name: add_file_from_buffer
method.description: Adds [param data] to the package as the file [param target_path], or replaces the entry with that path. If [param encrypt] is [code]true[/code], the file is encrypted with the key used by [method PCKPackageServer.build]. A description saved as [code].tres[/code] stores the data in the file.

method.name: add_removal
method.description: Adds a removal entry for [param path], or replaces the entry with that path. When the built pack is mounted, [param path] disappears from [code]res://[/code], even if an earlier pack provides it. Use it for patch packs that delete files.

method.name: get_entries
method.description: Returns one [PCKPackageEntry] per entry, in pack order, including removal entries (see [method add_removal]). Each entry is a snapshot: it does not change when the package is edited afterwards.

method.name: get_file_count
method.description: Returns the number of entries, including removal entries.

method.name: get_file_paths
method.description: Returns the paths of all files in pack order, with [code]res://[/code]. Removal entries are not included.

method.name: has_file
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the package has an entry for [param path], including a removal entry.

method.name: is_description
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the package is a pack description, that is, if it was not read from a [code].pck[/code] file and [member pack_path] is empty.

method.name: remove_file
method.description: Removes the entry for [param path] from the package. The built pack will not contain the file. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if there is no such entry.

method.name: rename_file
method.description: Moves the entry [param from] to the path [param to]. The renamed entry moves to the end of the pack order. Returns [constant ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] if [param from] is not in the package, and [constant ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS] if [param to] is.

method.name: set_key
method.description: Sets the key used to read encrypted files of the pack and of the [member base_pack], and to build when [method PCKPackageServer.build] gets no key: 64 hexadecimal characters, or an empty [String] for the script encryption key compiled into the engine. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for an invalid key. The key is only kept in memory. It is never saved with the resource, and there is no getter.

members.member: The alignment of file data in bytes, used by [method PCKPackageServer.build]. The pack format does not store it: [method PCKPackageServer.open] detects it from the file offsets (the largest power of two up to 4096 that divides all of them).

The pack that the files with the source type [constant SOURCE_PACK] are read from. Reading a pack sets it to [member pack_path]. When it is changed, all such files are read from the new base pack by their path.
If [code]true[/code], the file list of the pack is encrypted. Read from the pack by [method PCKPackageServer.open], and used by [method PCKPackageServer.build].
The engine version that wrote the pack, for example [code]"4.8.0"[/code]. Empty for a package that was not read from a pack.

The version of the pack format: [code]2[/code], [code]3[/code] or [code]4[/code]. [code]0[/code] for a package that was not read from a pack. [method PCKPackageServer.build] always writes the current format.

The path of the pack file the package was read from. Empty for a pack description. Not stored when the package is saved. [b]Note:[/b] [member Resource.resource_path] is the path of the resource file, which is the same for a loaded [code].pck[/code], but differs for a pack opened with [method PCKPackageServer.open] (empty) and for a description (the [code].tres[/code] file).

constants.constant: The data is a file of a pack: of [member pack_path] if the entry was read from it, otherwise of [member base_pack].
The data is read from a source file when the pack is built (see [method add_file]).
The data is held in memory (see [method add_file_from_buffer]).
